prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1376; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, reporting low back pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism is consistent in kind and force with the lumbar strain diagnosed. Over the course of 18 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and a graded home exercise program, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion, which support the clinical impression. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and straight-leg raise, was within normal limits. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Patient was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
